mapper.sql: SELECT z.id, z.name, z.description, z.created_at, COALESCE(s.cnt, 0) AS student_count, COALESCE(k.cnt, 0) AS course_count FROM clazz z LEFT JOIN (SELECT clazz_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clazz_student GROUP BY clazz_id) s ON s.clazz_id = z.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT clazz_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clazz_course GROUP BY clazz_id) k ON k.clazz_id = z.id
